title: Minerva (Head V1)
notes: Head V1+urdf: 3DP URDF 1.1 plus the head on a two-joint neck (neck_z pan, neck_y tilt). Arm joint frames match 1.1 within 0.005 mm.
Preview profile: the active model (../model.json) gains the neck only when its collision model covers the head. No collision model or limit review here.
Every range is the exporter's default of plus or minus pi, including the neck: not the servos' travel.
Gripper sliders move the CAD jaws in metres; both jaws follow the exported coupling. Motor-to-jaw calibration is not applied.
Source mass properties are missing. This is a kinematic view, not validated physics.
